title: SCAR: State-Space Compression for AI-Based Radio Resource Management of Vehicular Services
abstract: arXiv:2508.06243v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The increasing demand for connected vehicular services poses significant challenges for AI-based network and service management due to the high volume and rapid variability of network state information. Traditional management and control mechanisms struggle to scale when processing fine-grained metrics such as Channel Quality Indicators (CQIs) in dynamic vehicular environments. To address this challenge, we propose SCAR (State-Space Compression for AI-Based Radio Resource Management), an edge-assisted framework that abstracts high-dimensional CQI information into compact representations for AI-based management. SCAR employs machine-learning (ML)-based compression techniques, including clustering and radial basis function (RBF) networks, to reduce the dimensionality of CQI-derived state information while preserving essential features relevant to management decisions. translated_title: SCAR：面向车载服务基于AI的无线资源管理的状态空间压缩
translated_abstract: 车载联网服务需求的不断增长给基于AI的网络与服务管理带来了重大挑战，原因在于网络状态信息体量大且变化迅速。在动态车载环境中，传统的管理与控制机制在处理信道质量指示（CQI）等细粒度指标时难以扩展。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SCAR（面向基于AI的无线资源管理的状态空间压缩），这是一个边缘辅助框架，可将高维CQI信息抽象为紧凑的表示形式，供基于AI的管理使用。SCAR采用基于机器学习（ML）的压缩技术，包括聚类和径向基函数（RBF）网络，在保留与管理决策相关的基本特征的同时，降低CQI派生状态信息的维度。所得到的压缩状态被用于训练强化学习
tldr: SCAR框架利用聚类和径向基函数网络等机器学习压缩技术，将高维CQI状态信息压缩为紧凑表示，从而提升动态车载环境中基于AI的无线资源管理的可扩展性。
en_tdlr: SCAR is an edge-assisted framework that compresses high-dimensional CQI state information into compact representations using ML-based techniques such as clustering and RBF networks, enabling scalable AI-based radio resource management in dynamic vehicular environments.
